to.description: The one participant this signal is for. The host forwards it there and nowhere else.

kind.description: An SDP offer or answer, or one ICE candidate. `reset`: the sender's connections to `to` are new (its panel was rebuilt); close yours and negotiate afresh. `stereo`: what the sender's video is (VPX's VR preview on one eye or both).

sdp.description: The session description; present on offer and answer.

candidate.description: The browser's candidate line; empty for end-of-candidates.

stereo.description: Present on stereo: `sbs` = left eye | right eye side by side, `mono` = one picture, null = the sender does not know (the receiver guesses from the picture's shape).

description: any -> `to`, through the host: it forwards the frame to `to` only, `from` preserved. Sets up the peer-to-peer video and voice between two participants; never logged, never trusted for anything but media.
